args.rationale: The recommendation to purchase 800 units is rejected. The root cause of the projected shortage is delivery timing rather than a deficit in supply volume. Open order PO-505 (2,000 units from SUP-A) is currently scheduled for receipt on 2026-10-01. With daily demand of 100 units against 1,000 usable units on hand, stock out occurs on 2026-09-27, leading to 400 units of unmet demand over 4 days. Furthermore, ordering 800 units costs $12,000.00 from SUP-A or $14,000.00 from SUP-B, both exceeding the $10,000.00 budget constraint. Expediting PO-505 by 4 days to arrive on 2026-09-27 resolves all 400 units of unmet demand for an expedite fee of $450.00. Because $450.00 exceeds the $250.00 autonomy limit for expedite fees, this action requires buyer approval.
important_factors: Existing open order PO-505 for 2000 units from SUP-A can be expedited by 4 days to 2026-09-27 for $450.00.
Current usable stock of 1000 units covers demand until 2026-09-26; expediting PO-505 completely prevents the 400-unit stockout.
The recommended 800-unit purchase requires $12,000.00–$14,000.00, which exceeds the available budget limit of $10,000.00 and is infeasible.
The expedite fee of $450.00 exceeds the $250.00 autonomy expedite fee threshold, requiring buyer approval.
